t: So, You Want to Dress Like a Gangster? A Guide to Men’s Mafia Style
s: August 20, 2024 - Though he begins the film in military garb and ivy style, Michael Corleone’s suits become darker and more conservative once he embraces his new role in the family. His gray, charcoal, and black pinstripe suits are both dramatically roomy and finely tailored, with three-piece suits and double-breasted jackets featuring peak lapels making many appearances. These outfits are seen as the pinnacle of mafia style, and denote a degree of status and importance.
